Vehicles Machinery and Parts for sale.
ABS SOUTHERN LOGISTICS LTD are based in Portsmouth, we operate throughout the UK and Europe delivering varied loads, from waste paper to champagne! We specialise in refrigerated and containerised transport. We are always looking for new opitunities, please feel free to contact us with your requirements.
Whether you have a box or a 26 pallet load to be delivered ABS SOUTHERN LOGISTICS LTD can cover it. Get in touch with size, weight, destination and any other special instructions for your goods and we will get back to you with a competative price.
